targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM indicator_symbols WHERE active

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol,period_seconds) side,candle_epoch,period_seconds FROM indicator_signals ORDER BY symbol,period_seconds,candle_epoch DESC) s WHERE side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND extract(epoch from now()) < candle_epoch + 2 * period_seconds

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM indicator_symbols a CROSS JOIN (VALUES (300),(900),(3600)) p(period_seconds) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT side,candle_epoch FROM indicator_signals s WHERE s.symbol=a.symbol AND s.period_seconds=p.period_seconds ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE a.active AND (s.side IS NULL OR s.side = 'SEM SINAL' OR extract(epoch from now()) >= s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds)

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol,period_seconds) candle_epoch,period_seconds FROM indicator_signals ORDER BY symbol,period_seconds,candle_epoch DESC) s WHERE extract(epoch from now()) >= candle_epoch + 2 * period_seconds

panels.title: Ultima leitura por ativo e periodo

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.symbol, a.name AS ativo, CASE p.period_seconds WHEN 300 THEN 'M5' WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' ELSE 'H1' END AS periodo, CASE WHEN s.side IS NULL OR extract(epoch from now()) >= s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds THEN 'SEM SINAL' ELSE s.side END AS sinal, round((s.probability * 100)::numeric,1) AS prob_call_pct, to_timestamp(s.candle_epoch) AS vela_fechada, CASE WHEN s.side IS NULL THEN 'sem_dados' WHEN extract(epoch from now()) >= s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds THEN 'dados_atrasados' ELSE s.reason END AS estado, s.model_version AS modelo FROM indicator_symbols a CROSS JOIN (VALUES (300),(900),(3600)) p(period_seconds) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM indicator_signals x WHERE x.symbol=a.symbol AND x.period_seconds=p.period_seconds ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE a.active ORDER BY a.symbol,p.period_seconds
